overview_description.description: AHLI BANK SAOG offers products and services related to commercial banking. The bank is divided into two operating segments: retail banking and wholesale banking, which includes treasury and investment banking. Retail banking includes customer deposits, consumer loans, overdrafts, credit cards, and fund transfer facilities. Wholesale banking also includes deposits, including current accounts, term deposits, loans, advances, and institutional customers. It also includes loans, advances, and loans to individuals.

about_short_description.short_description: Ahli Bank is a joint stock firm that engages in commercial banking operations such as retail banking, corporate banking, and other services

product.name: Retail Banking
product.description: Banking services for individuals, including deposit accounts, personal lending, payment services, and everyday transaction support.

product.name: Corporate Banking
product.description: Financial services for companies, including business accounts, lending, cash management, trade finance, and payment solutions.

product.name: Business and SME Banking
product.description: Banking and financing services designed for small and medium-sized businesses and commercial enterprises.

product.name: Deposits and Accounts
product.description: Current, savings, and fixed-term deposit accounts for individuals and businesses to hold funds and manage transactions.

product.name: Loans and Credit Facilities
product.description: Personal and business financing, including consumer loans, mortgages, working-capital facilities, overdrafts, and term lending.

product.name: Cards and Payment Services
product.description: Debit and credit cards and related payment services for purchases, cash access, transfers, collections, and merchant transactions.
